name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Fly
steps: Lie on the bench with both feet planted and hold a dumbbell above your chest, palm facing inward.
Soften your working elbow and rest your free hand on your hip to help keep your torso steady.
Lower the dumbbell out to the side in a wide, controlled arc until your upper arm is roughly level with your torso.
Draw the weight back over your chest by squeezing your pec, and switch arms after completing one side.
tips: Keep both hips and shoulder blades anchored on the bench against the off-center pull.
Avoid straightening or overly bending your elbow as your arm opens wide.
